title: Booking a Haircut
intro: Bir kuaförden telefonla randevu alınan konuşmayı dinleyeceksin; gün, saat ve fiyata dikkat et.

segments.speaker: Receptionist
segments.text: Green Street Hair Salon. Good morning. How can I help you?

segments.speaker: Ayse
segments.text: Hello. I want an appointment for a haircut, please.

segments.speaker: Receptionist
segments.text: Of course. Which day are you free?

segments.speaker: Ayse
segments.text: Is Thursday morning OK? I finish work at twelve.

segments.speaker: Receptionist
segments.text: I'm sorry, Thursday is full. We've got Friday at half past ten.

segments.speaker: Ayse
segments.text: Friday is good for me. How much is a haircut?

segments.speaker: Receptionist
segments.text: It's twenty euros. Can I have your name, please?

segments.speaker: Ayse
segments.text: It's Ayse Demir. Thank you very much.

segments.speaker: Receptionist
segments.text: Thank you, Ayse. See you on Friday at half past ten.

questions.text: Which day is Ayse's appointment?
questions.explain: Görevli "We've got Friday at half past ten" diyor ve Ayse "Friday is good for me" diye cevaplıyor.

questions.text: What time is the appointment?
questions.explain: Konuşmanın sonunda "See you on Friday at half past ten" deniyor. On iki, Ayse'nin işten çıkış saati.

questions.text: A haircut is twenty euros.
questions.explain: Ayse "How much is a haircut?" diye soruyor, görevli "It's twenty euros" diyor. Yani doğru.

questions.text: Why can't Ayse come on Thursday?
options: Because the salon is full that day
questions.explain: Görevli "I'm sorry, Thursday is full" diyor; salon o gün dolu, kapalı değil.

questions.text: A haircut is ___ euros.
questions.explain: "It's twenty euros." Fiyatı resepsiyon söylüyor.

questions.text: What is the customer's family name?
questions.explain: "It's Ayse Demir." Soyadı Demir.

title: Delay at Central Station
intro: Bir tren istasyonunda peron ve gecikme bilgisi veren anonsu dinleyeceksin.

segments.speaker: Announcement
segments.text: Good morning. Welcome to Central Station. This is an announcement for all passengers. The train to Manchester is leaving from platform five at nine fifteen. Please go to platform five now.

segments.speaker: Announcement
segments.text: The train to Liverpool is late. It's coming at ten forty, not ten twenty. We're very sorry. Passengers for Liverpool can wait in the café next to platform three. It's open now.

segments.speaker: Announcement
segments.text: Tickets are eight pounds fifty. There's a ticket machine near the main door. Please don't leave your bags. Thank you and have a good day.

questions.text: Which platform is the Manchester train leaving from?
questions.explain: Anonsta "The train to Manchester is leaving from platform five at nine fifteen." deniyor. Manchester treni beşinci perondan kalkıyor.

questions.text: The train to Liverpool is late.
questions.explain: "The train to Liverpool is late." cümlesi bunu açıkça söylüyor, bu yüzden doğru.

questions.text: What time is the Liverpool train coming?
questions.explain: "It's coming at ten forty, not ten twenty." deniyor. Yani eski saat 10:20 değil, yeni saat 10:40.

questions.text: Where can passengers for Liverpool wait?
options: In the café next to platform three
questions.explain: "Passengers for Liverpool can wait in the café next to platform three." cümlesinden anlıyoruz; kafe üç numaralı peronun yanında ve açık.

questions.text: Tickets are eight pounds ___.
questions.explain: "Tickets are eight pounds fifty."

questions.text: Where is the ticket machine?
questions.explain: "There's a ticket machine near the main door."

title: At the Clothes Shop
intro: Bir mağazada müşterinin ceket için beden, renk ve fiyat sorduğu konuşmayı dinleyeceksin.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Excuse me. I like this jacket. Have you got it in a small?

segments.speaker: Assistant
segments.text: Let me check. Sorry, we haven't got small. There's medium and large.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: OK, medium is fine. Have you got it in black? Blue isn't my color.

segments.speaker: Assistant
segments.text: Sure. We've got black, blue and green. The black one is very nice.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Great. How much is it?

segments.speaker: Assistant
segments.text: It's forty dollars. The green one is thirty dollars.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: The black one, please. Can I pay by card?

segments.speaker: Assistant
segments.text: Of course. The fitting room is over there. You can try it now.

questions.text: What color does the customer want?
questions.explain: Müşteri "Have you got it in black? Blue isn't my color." diyor ve sonunda "The black one, please." diye seçiyor.

questions.text: How much is the black jacket?
questions.explain: Görevli "It's forty dollars. The green one is thirty dollars." diyor; kırk dolar siyah olanın fiyatı.

questions.text: The shop has got the jacket in small.
questions.explain: Görevli "Sorry, we haven't got small. There's medium and large." diyor, yani küçük beden yok.

questions.text: How does the customer want to pay?
questions.explain: Müşteri "Can I pay by card?" diye soruyor, görevli de "Of course." diye cevap veriyor.

questions.text: The green jacket is ___ dollars.
questions.explain: "It's forty dollars. The green one is thirty dollars." Müşteri siyahı alıyor.

questions.text: Which size does the customer take?
questions.explain: Küçük beden yok; müşteri "OK, medium is fine" diyor.

title: The Family Photo
intro: İki arkadaşın bir aile fotoğrafındaki kişileri konuştuğu diyaloğu dinleyeceksin.

segments.speaker: Emma
segments.text: Oh, is this your family photo? Can I see it?

segments.speaker: Kaan
segments.text: Sure. It's from my sister's birthday. There are six people here.

segments.speaker: Emma
segments.text: Who's the woman with short blonde hair?

segments.speaker: Kaan
segments.text: That's my aunt Julia. She's my mother's sister. She's a nurse.

segments.speaker: Emma
segments.text: And the tall man with glasses?

segments.speaker: Kaan
segments.text: That's my uncle. He's very tall, and he's got a big beard now.

segments.speaker: Emma
segments.text: Your sister looks young. How old is she?

segments.speaker: Kaan
segments.text: She's nineteen. She's studying music in London.

segments.speaker: Emma
segments.text: You two look the same! Same eyes, same smile.

questions.text: How many people are in the photo?
questions.explain: Kaan fotoğrafı gösterirken "There are six people here." diyor. Yani fotoğrafta altı kişi var.

questions.text: Julia is the sister of Kaan's mother.
questions.explain: Kaan "That's my aunt Julia. She's my mother's sister." diyor. Julia, annesinin kız kardeşi, yani teyzesi.

questions.text: What is Kaan's sister studying?
questions.explain: Kaan kız kardeşi için "She's nineteen. She's studying music in London." diyor.

questions.text: How does Kaan describe his uncle?
options: He is tall and he has got a beard.
He is short and he hasn't got glasses.
He has got short blonde hair.
questions.explain: Emma "the tall man with glasses" diye soruyor, Kaan da "He's very tall, and he's got a big beard now." diye cevaplıyor.

questions.text: Kaan's sister is ___ years old.
questions.explain: "She's nineteen. She's studying music in London."

questions.text: Where is Kaan's sister studying?
questions.explain: "She's studying music in London."

title: A Weekend Voice Message
intro: Bir arkadaşının hafta sonu planı için bıraktığı sesli mesajı dinleyeceksin.

segments.speaker: Voice message
segments.text: Hi Ayşe, it's Mert. I'm calling about the weekend. There's a music festival in the new park near the river. I'm going to meet Deniz there on Saturday at eleven o'clock.

segments.speaker: Voice message
segments.text: Can you come with us? The tickets are only twenty lira for students. That's cheap! I've got a big bag with sandwiches, so don't bring food. But please bring your camera.

segments.speaker: Voice message
segments.text: Saturday is sunny, but Sunday is rainy, so Saturday is better. Call me back tonight. My phone is on. Bye!

questions.text: What time are they meeting in the park?
questions.explain: Mert "I'm going to meet Deniz there on Saturday at eleven o'clock." diyor, yani buluşma saat on birde.

questions.text: How much is a student ticket?
questions.explain: "The tickets are only twenty lira for students." cümlesinden öğrenci biletinin yirmi lira olduğu anlaşılıyor.

questions.text: Mert wants Ayşe to bring food.
questions.explain: Yanlış. Mert "I've got a big bag with sandwiches, so don't bring food." diyor; yemeği kendisi getiriyor, ondan sadece fotoğraf makinesini istiyor.

questions.text: Why is Saturday better than Sunday?
options: Because the park is closed on Sunday
Because Deniz is busy on Sunday
questions.explain: "Saturday is sunny, but Sunday is rainy, so Saturday is better." cümlesinde pazar gününün yağmurlu olduğu söyleniyor.

questions.explain: "The tickets are only twenty lira for students."

questions.text: What does Mert ask Ayşe to bring?
questions.explain: "don't bring food. But please bring your camera." Yiyeceği Mert getiriyor.

title: At the Doctor's
intro: Bir hastanın doktora şikâyetlerini anlattığı konuşmayı dinleyeceksin.

segments.speaker: Doctor
segments.text: Good morning. Come in, please. What's the matter?

segments.speaker: Merve
segments.text: Good morning. I'm not feeling well. I've got a headache and a sore throat.

segments.speaker: Doctor
segments.text: Have you got a fever?

segments.speaker: Merve
segments.text: Yes. This morning it's 38 degrees.

segments.speaker: Doctor
segments.text: Okay. Open your mouth, please. Your throat is very red. It's just a bad cold.

segments.speaker: Merve
segments.text: Can you give me something for the pain?

segments.speaker: Doctor
segments.text: Sure. Here's a prescription. Take one tablet three times a day, after meals.

segments.speaker: Merve
segments.text: Thank you. Can I go to work tomorrow?

segments.speaker: Doctor
segments.text: No, stay at home for two days. Drink a lot of water. Come back on Friday.

questions.text: What is Merve's problem?
options: A headache and a sore throat
questions.explain: Merve doktora 'I've got a headache and a sore throat.' diyor; yani başı ve boğazı ağrıyor.

questions.text: What is her temperature this morning?
questions.explain: Ateşi sorulunca 'Yes. This morning it's 38 degrees.' diyor.

questions.text: Merve can go to work tomorrow.
questions.explain: Doktor 'No, stay at home for two days.' diyor; yani yarın işe gidemez, iki gün evde kalacak.

questions.text: How many tablets a day does she take?
questions.explain: Doktor 'Take one tablet three times a day, after meals.' diyor; günde üç kez birer hap, yani üç hap.

questions.text: Merve must stay at home for ___ days.
questions.explain: "stay at home for two days." Yarın işe gidemiyor.

questions.text: When must Merve come back?
questions.explain: "Come back on Friday."

title: Gym Opening Hours
intro: Bir spor salonunun telefon bilgi kaydını dinleyeceksin: hangi gün, saat kaçta açık olduklarını ve fiyatları anlatıyor.

segments.text: Hello, and thank you for calling City Sport Gym. We're open every day. From Monday to Friday, we open at six in the morning and close at ten at night.

segments.speaker: Announcement
segments.text: On Saturday, we're open from eight to eight. On Sunday we close early, at six in the evening. Our swimming pool is open in the afternoon only.

segments.speaker: Announcement
segments.text: A one-month card is thirty euros for students and forty-five euros for other members. Yoga classes are on Tuesday and Thursday evenings at seven. Please press one to talk to a person. Thank you!

questions.text: What time does the gym open from Monday to Friday?

questions.text: On Saturday the gym is open until eight in the evening.
questions.explain: "On Saturday, we're open from eight to eight" cümlesi sabah sekizden akşam sekize kadar açık olduklarını söylüyor, yani doğru.

questions.text: How much is a one-month card for students?
questions.explain: "A one-month card is thirty euros for students" deniyor; kırk beş euro öğrenci olmayan üyeler için.

questions.text: When are the yoga classes?

questions.text: On Sunday the gym closes at ___ in the evening.
questions.explain: "On Sunday we close early, at six in the evening."

questions.text: When is the swimming pool open?

title: A Weekend in Izmir
intro: İki arkadaşın geçen hafta sonu ne yaptıklarını anlattığı konuşmayı dinleyeceksin.

segments.speaker: Emre
segments.text: Hi Deniz! How was your weekend?

segments.text: It was great! I went to Izmir with my sister.

questions.text: The dinner was 200 lira for two people.

title: Introduce Yourself
intro: Kurs forumuna kendini tanıtan kısa bir mesaj yazmayı çalışacaksın: adın, nereli olduğun, mesleğin ve hobilerin.

tasks.answer: Hello, my name is Elif.
alternatives: Hello, my name's Elif.
Hi, my name is Elif.
Hello, my name is Elif
Hello, my name's Elif
tasks.hint: Kendini tanıtırken 'my name is ...' kalıbını kullan; 'name is' kısaltılırsa 'name's' olur.

tasks.answer: I'm from Turkey and I'm a student.
alternatives: I am from Turkey and I am a student.
I am from Turkey and I'm a student.
I'm from Turkey and I am a student.
I'm from Turkey and I'm a student
tasks.hint: Ülke söylerken 'from' gelir: I am from Turkey. 'I am' kısaltılınca 'I'm' olur.

tasks.answer: I like listening to music in my free time.
alternatives: I like to listen to music in my free time.
In my free time, I like listening to music.
I like listening to music in my free time
In my free time I like to listen to music.
tasks.hint: 'like' fiilinden sonra -ing ya da 'to' + fiil gelir: I like listening / I like to listen.

tasks.prompt: Kurs forumuna kendini tanıtan kısa bir mesaj yaz. Şu üçüne değin: (1) nereli olduğun ve nerede yaşadığın, (2) ne iş yaptığın ya da öğrenci olduğun, (3) boş zamanında ne yapmayı sevdiğin. Selamlama ile başla, kapanış cümlesiyle bitir.
checklist: Adını ve nereli olduğunu yazdın mı?
Mesleğini ya da öğrenci olduğunu 'I'm a ...' kalıbıyla söyledin mi?
Boş zamanında ne yapmayı sevdiğini anlattın mı?
Selamlama ve kapanış cümlesi (ör. 'Nice to meet you.') koydun mu?

phrases.de: I'm from ... and I live in ...
I'm a student. / I work in a ...
In my free time, I like ...

tasks.sample: Hello, everyone! My name is Elif and I'm from Turkey. I live in Izmir with my family. I'm a student, and I also work in a small cafe at the weekend. In my free time, I like listening to music and reading books. I want to speak English every day here. Nice to meet you all!

I am going to the cinema this Saturday
I'm going to the cinema this Saturday
I'm going to the cinema on Saturday.
I am going to the cinema on Saturday.

title: How Was Your Weekend?
intro: Elif ile Kerem'in hafta sonlarını anlattıkları mesajlaşmayı okuyacaksın.
text:
Elif, 10:14
Hi Kerem! How was your weekend? I called you on Saturday but you never answered.

Kerem, 10:20
Sorry! I was on a train to Bursa. My cousin got married on Saturday evening, so the whole family travelled together.

Elif, 10:22
Wow, a wedding! Did you dance?

Kerem, 10:25
Of course. The music was louder than last year's party and we stayed until one o'clock. My little brother fell asleep on a chair.

Elif, 10:27
Poor kid. My weekend was quieter. I used to hate cooking, but now I really enjoy it. On Sunday I made lentil soup for my neighbours.

Kerem, 10:30
That sounds better than my Sunday. I slept until noon and then I cleaned the car.

Elif, 10:31
Have you finished your report yet?

Kerem, 10:33
Not yet! I must start tonight. I have never written thirty pages in one week.

Elif, 10:35
Good luck. I will bring you a cup of soup tomorrow. It is the best thing I have ever cooked.

title: My Life in Three Cities
intro: Elif'in kendi hayat hikâyesini anlattığı blog yazısını okuyacaksın.
text:
MY LIFE IN THREE CITIES
Posted by Elif Kaya · March 14

Hello! I have had this blog for two years now, but I have never told you my own story. So here it is.

I grew up in Izmir. My father was a fisherman, and I used to help him on the boat every summer. I hated it when I was ten. Now I miss it.

When I was nineteen, I moved to Ankara to study engineering. I was terrible at it. One evening, while I was studying for an exam, I started drawing small houses in my notebook. My teacher saw them and said, "You should study design."

I have lived in Istanbul since 2019. I work for a small studio near Kadıköy, and I have already designed four cafés. It is harder than engineering, but it is much more fun.

Next year I am going to open my own studio. I am a little afraid, but my father always says the same thing: "A fisherman must not wait for good weather." He is right.

Have you ever changed your job? Tell me below!

text:
GREEN VALLEY HEALTH CENTRE
Free Wellness Programme — October

Do you feel tired every morning? Small changes can help.

SLEEP
You should go to bed before eleven o'clock. Avoid your phone in bed. Screens make sleep harder.

FOOD
Drink six glasses of water a day. You should eat fruit at breakfast. Avoid sugar in the afternoon — it gives you energy for twenty minutes only.

MOVE
Walking is the easiest exercise. Thirty minutes a day is enough. Our nurse, Elif Kaya, says: "I used to drive to work. Now I walk, and I feel much stronger than before."

JOIN US
Free classes every Tuesday at 6 p.m. in Room 4.
Yoga for beginners — bring a towel.
Cooking workshop — first Saturday of the month, 10 a.m.

We have already helped 300 people this year. You must call before you come, because the classes are small. Ring 0212 555 04 18.

Your health will thank you!

I used to work in a small pizza place in Izmir, and I made coffee every morning. I have never worked in England before, but I studied English at school for six years.

NOTICE — RETURNS AND EXCHANGES

Dear customers,

We changed our returns policy last month, so please read this notice.

You can bring an item back within 30 days. You must show the receipt. Without a receipt we cannot give your money back, but we can offer an exchange or a store card.

CLOTHES: please keep the label on the item. We have already helped hundreds of shoppers this year, and the label makes everything faster.

SHOES: you must not wear them outside. We only accept shoes in the original box.

SALE ITEMS: these things are cheaper, so the rules are stricter. We exchange them, but we never give money back for them.

ELECTRONICS: you have 14 days. Please bring the box, the cable and the charger.

The returns desk is on the second floor, next to the coffee shop. It opens at 10:00 every day and closes at 19:00. On Sundays it closes earlier, at 17:00.

Elif Demir, our new manager, will answer your questions on Saturday morning.

Thank you!

title: Old Mill Bridge Opens Again
intro: Yerel bir gazetede çıkan, yeniden açılan bir köprü haberini okuyacaksın.
text:
RIVERTON DAILY — Local News

Old Mill Bridge Opens Again
By Clara Novak, 12 May

The Old Mill Bridge opened again on Saturday morning after six months of repair work. More than three hundred people came to the small park next to the river at nine o'clock.

The mayor, Deniz Yalın, cut the red ribbon. "This bridge is safer and wider than the old one," she said. "Children can walk to school here now."

The bridge closed last November because heavy rain damaged the stone under it. While the workers were fixing it, people used the bus or drove ten kilometres to the next bridge. Many shops near the river lost money.

"I have lived here for thirty years, and I have never seen the bridge closed before," said Mr Owens, who sells bread on Green Street. "My customers are already coming back."

The town spent 1.2 million euros on the project. The council will plant fifty new trees along the river path next spring. Visitors should use the free car park behind the library.

title: Headphones and a Receipt
intro: Bir mağazada bozuk bir kulaklığı iade etmeye çalışan müşteri ile görevli arasındaki konuşmayı dinleyeceksin.

segments.speaker: Emre
segments.text: Hello. I bought these headphones here last Saturday, but they don't work. There is no sound on the left side.

segments.speaker: Assistant
segments.text: I'm sorry about that. Do you have the receipt?

segments.speaker: Emre
segments.text: Yes, here it is. I paid 450 lira.

segments.speaker: Assistant
segments.text: Thank you. The warranty is two years, so this isn't a problem. Do you want your money back, or a new pair?

segments.speaker: Emre
segments.text: A new pair, please. These were the cheapest ones, but my old ones were better.

segments.speaker: Assistant
segments.text: Of course. We have the same model in black. I'll get it from the storeroom.

segments.speaker: Emre
segments.text: Great. How long does it take?

segments.speaker: Assistant
segments.text: About two minutes. And please keep the receipt. You must show it for any repair.

segments.speaker: Emre
segments.text: Sure. Thank you very much.

questions.text: What is the problem with the headphones?
options: There is no sound on the left side.
questions.explain: Emre ilk cümlesinde "There is no sound on the left side." diyor, yani sol taraftan ses gelmiyor.

questions.text: Emre has the receipt with him.
questions.explain: Görevli "Do you have the receipt?" diye sorunca Emre "Yes, here it is." diyor; fiş yanında.

title: Tech Support Call
intro: Bir teknik destek hattını arayan müşterinin telefon görüşmesini dinleyeceksin.

segments.speaker: Emma
segments.text: Good afternoon, TechCare support. My name is Emma. How can I help you?

segments.speaker: Deniz
segments.text: Hi Emma. My name is Deniz. My laptop doesn't connect to the internet. I tried everything.

segments.speaker: Emma
segments.text: I'm sorry about that. Have you restarted the router already?

segments.speaker: Deniz
segments.text: Yes, twice. The small light on the front is orange, not green.

segments.speaker: Emma
segments.text: Okay. An orange light usually means a cable problem. Look at the back of the router. Is the black cable in the yellow port?

segments.speaker: Deniz
segments.text: Just a second... No, it's in the grey one.

segments.speaker: Emma
segments.text: That's the problem. Move it to the yellow port and wait two minutes.

segments.speaker: Deniz
segments.text: It's green now! Thank you so much. Do I have to pay for this call?

segments.speaker: Emma
segments.text: No, the call is free. Only home visits cost money. They're 30 pounds. Your reference number is four one nine.

questions.text: Why does Deniz call the support line?
options: He can't find his reference number.
He wants to buy a new router.
His laptop doesn't connect to the internet.
questions.explain: Deniz konuşmanın başında 'My laptop doesn't connect to the internet.' diyor. Sorun internet bağlantısı.

questions.text: Deniz restarted the router two times.
questions.explain: Emma 'Have you restarted the router already?' diye soruyor, Deniz 'Yes, twice.' yani iki kez diye cevap veriyor.

questions.text: Where was the black cable at the beginning?
questions.explain: Emma sarı portu soruyor, Deniz bakıp 'No, it's in the grey one.' diyor. Kablo yanlışlıkla gri porttaydı.

questions.text: How much does a home visit cost?
questions.explain: Emma 'Only home visits cost money. They're 30 pounds.' diyor. Ücretsiz olan telefon görüşmesi; 419 ise referans numarası.

questions.text: The black cable must go in the ___ port.
questions.explain: "Is the black cable in the yellow port?" Kablo gri portta olduğu için bağlanmıyordu.

questions.text: What is Deniz's reference number?
questions.explain: "Your reference number is four one nine."

title: Weekend Trip to Izmir
intro: İki arkadaşın hafta sonu gezi planını konuştuğu sohbeti dinleyeceksin.

segments.speaker: Mert
segments.text: Eda, are you free next weekend? My brother and I are going to visit Izmir.

segments.speaker: Eda
segments.text: Really? I've never been there. How are you going to travel?

segments.speaker: Mert
segments.text: By bus. It's cheaper than the plane. The ticket is only 350 lira.

segments.speaker: Eda
segments.text: That's nice. What time does the bus leave?

segments.speaker: Mert
segments.text: At seven in the morning, on Saturday. We'll arrive around one o'clock.

segments.speaker: Eda
segments.text: That's a long trip! Will you stay in a hotel?

segments.speaker: Mert
segments.text: No, my cousin has a flat near the sea. We're going to stay there for three nights.

segments.speaker: Eda
segments.text: Sounds great. I'll ask my boss tomorrow, and then I'll call you.

segments.speaker: Mert
segments.text: Perfect. Don't forget your camera. The sunsets there are the best in Turkey.

questions.explain: Mert "At seven in the morning, on Saturday." diyor. Saat bir, otobüsün varış saati.

title: Tech Minute: A Small Idea
intro: Teknoloji üzerine kısa bir podcast bölümünü dinleyeceksin; sunucu genç bir öğrencinin uygulamasını anlatıyor.

segments.speaker: Podcast host
segments.text: Hello, and welcome to Tech Minute. I'm Emma, and this is our Tuesday show. Today I want to talk about a small idea.

segments.speaker: Podcast host
segments.text: Two years ago, a student in Ankara made an app for people who always lose their keys. He calls it KeyFriend. He was only nineteen.

segments.speaker: Podcast host
segments.text: He worked on it every night after his classes. His friends didn't like it at first. Now more than 400,000 people use the app.

segments.speaker: Podcast host
segments.text: It's free, but the special version costs 3 dollars a month. Next week he will open a small office in Istanbul. So, remember: a good idea doesn't need a lot of money. It needs time.

questions.text: Who is the app for?
options: People who can't find a taxi
People who always lose their keys
questions.explain: Sunucu "he made an app for people who always lose their keys" diyor; uygulama anahtarlarını kaybedenler için.

questions.text: How old was the student when he made the app?
questions.explain: "He was only nineteen" cümlesinden anlıyoruz; öğrenci o zaman on dokuz yaşındaydı.

questions.text: The app is completely free for everyone.
questions.explain: Yanlış. "It's free, but the special version costs 3 dollars a month" — özel sürüm ayda 3 dolar.

options: Sell the app to a big company
Open a small office in Istanbul
questions.explain: "Next week he will open a small office in Istanbul" diyor; gelecek hafta İstanbul'da küçük bir ofis açacak.

questions.text: The special version costs ___ dollars a month.
questions.explain: "It's free, but the special version costs 3 dollars a month."

questions.text: How many people use the app now?
questions.explain: "Now more than 400,000 people use the app."

title: My Weekend Message
intro: Hafta sonunu anlatmak için geçmiş zamanı ve sık kullanılan düzensiz fiilleri (go → went, have → had, buy → bought) çalışacaksın.

tasks.tr: Geçen hafta sonu ailemi ziyaret ettim.
tasks.answer: Last weekend I visited my family.
alternatives: Last weekend, I visited my family.
I visited my family last weekend.
I visited my family last weekend
tasks.hint: Düzenli fiillerin geçmiş hâli -ed alır: visit → visited.

tasks.answer: My friends and I went to the beach on Saturday.
alternatives: On Saturday, we went to the beach with my friends.
We went to the beach with my friends on Saturday.
On Saturday we went to the beach with our friends.
On Saturday my friends and I went to the beach.
I went to the beach with my friends on Saturday.
On Saturday we went to the beach with my friends.
tasks.hint: 'go' düzensizdir: geçmiş hâli 'goed' değil 'went' olur.

tasks.answer: I didn't do anything on Sunday.
alternatives: I did not do anything on Sunday.
I didn't do anything on Sunday
I did not do anything on Sunday
On Sunday I didn't do anything.
On Sunday I did not do anything.
tasks.hint: Olumsuzda 'didn't' kullanılır ve fiil yalın kalır: didn't do (did not did değil).

tasks.prompt: Arkadaşına hafta sonunu anlatan bir mesaj yaz. Şu üçüne değin: (1) hafta sonu nereye gittin ve kiminleydin, (2) orada ne yaptın (en az iki etkinlik anlat), (3) hafta sonun nasıl geçti ve arkadaşına ne öneriyorsun.
checklist: Nereye gittiğini ve kiminle olduğunu yazdın mı?
En az iki etkinliği geçmiş zamanla anlattın mı?
Düzensiz fiilleri doğru yazdın mı (went, had, bought, ate)?
Mesajı bir selamlama ile başlatıp kapanış cümlesiyle bitirdin mi?

phrases.de: Hi Emre! How was your weekend?
You should come with us next time.
phrases.tr: Bir dahaki sefere sen de bizimle gelmelisin.

tasks.sample: Hi Emre! How was your weekend? Last weekend I went to my grandmother's village with my family. On Saturday we walked in the forest and cooked outside. The market was very crowded on Sunday, but we bought fresh bread and cheese there. I came home tired, but I had a great time. You should come with us next month. Write back soon!

title: My Story in a Comment
intro: Bir blog yazısının altına kendi hikâyeni yazarken present perfect ile geçmiş zamanı birlikte kullanmayı çalışacaksın.

tasks.answer: I've studied English for two years.
alternatives: I have studied English for two years.
I have studied English for two years
I've studied English for two years
I have been studying English for two years.
I've been studying English for two years.
tasks.hint: Hâlâ süren bir durumu anlatmak için present perfect ve 'for' + süre kullanılır: I have studied … for two years.

tasks.tr: Geçen yaz ilk kez İstanbul'a gittim.
tasks.answer: Last summer I went to Istanbul for the first time.
alternatives: I went to Istanbul for the first time last summer.
Last summer, I went to Istanbul for the first time.
I went to Istanbul for the first time last summer
Last summer I went to Istanbul for the first time
tasks.hint: Belli bir geçmiş zaman ('last summer') varsa present perfect değil, past simple kullanılır: go fiilinin ikinci hâli went.

tasks.tr: Bu kitabı henüz okumadım ama çok merak ediyorum.
tasks.answer: I haven't read this book yet, but I'm really curious.
alternatives: I have not read this book yet, but I am really curious.
I haven't read this book yet but I'm really curious.
I have not read this book yet but I am really curious.
I have not read this book yet, but I am really curious
I haven't read this book yet, but I am really curious.
I have not read this book yet, but I'm really curious.
I've not read this book yet, but I am really curious.
I've not read this book yet, but I'm really curious.
tasks.hint: 'yet' olumsuz cümlenin sonuna gelir ve present perfect ile kullanılır: I haven't read it yet.

tasks.prompt: Bir dil öğrenme blogunda 'İngilizceyi nasıl öğrendim?' başlıklı bir yazı okudun. Yazının altına kendi hikâyeni anlatan kısa bir yorum yaz. Şu üçüne değin: (1) ne kadar zamandır İngilizce çalıştığın, (2) geçmişte yaşadığın somut bir anı (nerede, ne zaman, ne oldu), (3) henüz yapmadığın ama yakında yapmak istediğin bir şey.
checklist: Yazara bir selamlama ya da teşekkür cümlesiyle başladın mı?
Ne kadar zamandır çalıştığını 'for' veya 'since' ile present perfect kullanarak yazdın mı?
Geçmişteki anıyı past simple ile (went, was, talked gibi) anlattın mı?
Henüz yapmadığın şeyi 'haven't … yet' kalıbıyla belirtip yorumu kısa bir kapanışla bitirdin mi?
tasks.sample: Hi Deniz, thanks for this post! I've studied English for two years, and your story sounds like mine. Last summer I went to Istanbul for the first time and I spoke English with tourists there. I was very nervous, but the people were kind and they understood me. I haven't finished your book list yet, but I will start it this week. Have you ever tried a language exchange app? Thanks again and keep writing!

title: A Problem in the Flat
intro: Ev sahibine yazılan kısa bir e-postada evdeki arızayı bildirmeyi, sorunun ne zamandır sürdüğünü anlatmayı ve kibarca yardım istemeyi çalışacaksın.

tasks.answer: Hello, I'm your tenant on the third floor.
alternatives: Hello, I am your tenant on the third floor.
Hi, I'm your tenant on the third floor.
Hi, I am your tenant on the third floor.
tasks.hint: Kendini tanıtırken 'I'm' = 'I am'; kat söylerken 'on' kullanılır: on the third floor.

tasks.answer: The heater hasn't worked since yesterday evening.
alternatives: The heater has not worked since yesterday evening.
The heater hasn't been working since yesterday evening.
The heater has not been working since yesterday evening.
tasks.hint: Belirli bir başlangıç anı için 'since' kullanılır ve fiil present perfect olur: hasn't worked since… ('hasn't' = 'has not').

tasks.tr: Sıcak su olmadığı için duş alamıyorum.
tasks.answer: I can't take a shower because there's no hot water.
alternatives: I cannot take a shower because there is no hot water.
I can't have a shower because there's no hot water.
I cannot have a shower because there is no hot water.
I cannot take a shower because there's no hot water.
I can't take a shower because there is no hot water.
I cannot have a shower because there's no hot water.
I can't have a shower because there is no hot water.
tasks.hint: Bir şeyin hiç olmadığını söylerken 'there is no + isim' dersin; 'can't' = 'cannot'.

tasks.prompt: Ev sahibine dairedeki bir arızayı bildiren kısa bir e-posta yaz. Şu üçüne değin: (1) hangi arıza var ve ne zamandan beri sürüyor, (2) bu durum günlük hayatını nasıl etkiliyor, (3) ne yapmasını rica ediyorsun ve evde hangi saatlerde bulunuyorsun.
checklist: Hitap ve kapanış cümlesi (ör. 'Dear …' ve 'Best wishes') yazdın mı?
Arızanın ne zamandan beri sürdüğünü 'since' veya 'for' ile söyledin mi?
Sorunun seni nasıl etkilediğini en az bir cümleyle anlattın mı?
Ricanı kibar bir soruyla ('Could you please …?') yazdın ve evde olduğun saati belirttin mi?

phrases.de: I am writing about a problem in my flat.
Could you please send someone to repair it?
phrases.tr: Lütfen tamir için birini gönderebilir misiniz?

phrases.de: I am at home after five o'clock.

tasks.sample:
Dear Mr Brown,

I am writing about a problem in my flat. The heater hasn't worked since yesterday evening, so there is no hot water in the bathroom. The rooms are very cold at night and I can't take a shower before work.

Could you please send someone to repair it this week? I am at home after five o'clock every day.

Thank you for your help.

Best wishes,
Elif

title: School Trip to the Zoo
intro: Öğretmenin velilere gönderdiği kısa mektubu oku: gezi ne zaman, kaç para, çocuk yanında ne getirecek.

Dear parents,

On Friday, May 10, class 3B goes to the city zoo. We meet at school at half past eight and come back at three o'clock.

The trip costs five euros. Please give the money to the teacher on Monday.

Your child needs a small bag, lunch, water and good shoes. The zoo is big and we walk a lot!

Phones stay at home. Cameras are okay.

Thank you,
Ms. Carter

title: Lost Property at the Bus Station
intro: Nadia otobüste çantasını unutmuş; kayıp eşya bürosundaki görevliyle konuşmasını dinle.

segments.speaker: Nadia
segments.text: Yes, please. I lost my bag on the bus this morning.

segments.speaker: Officer
segments.text: Okay. Which bus?

segments.speaker: Nadia
segments.text: Bus number twenty-two, at about nine o'clock.

segments.speaker: Officer
segments.text: What color is the bag?

segments.speaker: Nadia

segments.speaker: Officer
segments.text: And what is in the bag?

title: th: think and this
intro: Türkçede olmayan „th“ sesi: dilin ucu dişlerin arasında. Yedi cümlede t, s ve d'ye kaçmadan söyle.

tasks.hint: „th“: dilin ucunu üst dişlerine değdir ve hava üfle. t değil, s değil.

confusions.fix: Dilin ucu dişlerin arasında, sessiz üfleme: „thank“. „tank“ ve „sank“ başka kelimeler.

tasks.de: I think this is my bag.
tasks.hint: „think“ sessiz th (üfleme), „this“ sesli th (titreşimli). İkisinde de dil dişlerin arasında.

confusions.fix: „think“te t ya da s değil, dişler arasından üfle; „this“te aynı yerde titreşim.

tasks.hint: „thirty-three“: iki kez sessiz th. „brother“ ortasındaki th sesli.

confusions.fix: Her iki th'de dil dişlerin arasında; „tree“ (ağaç) ve „free“ (bedava) başka kelimeler.

tasks.de: The weather is good on Thursday.
tasks.hint: „the“ ve „weather“: sesli th. „Thursday“: sessiz th.

confusions.fix: „the“ d ile değil, dişler arasında titreşimle. „Thursday“ Tuesday ile karışmasın: th üfle.

tasks.hint: „third“ = sessiz th + kısa ı sesi; r duyulmasa da olur.

confusions.fix: „third“ baştaki th üflemeli; t ile söylersen kaba bir kelime çıkar.

tasks.hint: „both“ sonu sessiz th; „them“ başı sesli th.

confusions.fix: „both“ kelime sonunda dişler arasından üfle; „boat“ (tekne) olmasın.

tasks.de: I have three brothers and a mother.
tasks.tr: Üç erkek kardeşim ve bir annem var.
tasks.hint: „three“ sessiz th; „brothers“ ve „mother“ sesli th.

confusions.fix: „three“ t ya da f değil, üflemeli th. „mother“ d ile değil, titreşimli th.

title: do or does?
intro: Alışkanlıkları anlatırken fiilin ne zaman -s aldığını ve soruda do/does'ın nasıl çalıştığını öğren.
focus: Present simple: do / does ve üçüncü tekilde -s

explanation.heading: Ne zaman kullanılır?
explanation.tr: Alışkanlık, rutin ve genel doğrular için: her sabah kahve içmek, bir şehirde yaşamak. Türkçede -r/-ir eki ne yapıyorsa (içerim, yaşarım) present simple onu yapar.

examples.de: I drink coffee every morning.
She lives in Berlin.
They work at a bank.

explanation.heading: Üçüncü tekilde -s
explanation.tr: he / she / it ile fiil -s alır: work → works, live → lives. Sonu -o, -sh, -ch ile bitenlerde -es: goes, watches. „have“ düzensiz: has.

examples.de: He works in a shop.
She watches TV in the evening.
My brother has a dog.

explanation.heading: Soru ve olumsuz: do / does
explanation.tr: Soruda ve olumsuzda yardımcı fiil do/does gelir ve -s yardımcıya geçer: Does she work? — She doesn't work. Asıl fiil yalın kalır, -s almaz.

examples.de: Do you like tea?
Does he speak English?
We don't eat fish.

questions.text: She ___ in Izmir.
questions.explain: „she“ üçüncü tekil: live → lives. „is live“ diye bir biçim yok.

questions.text: ___ you like coffee?
questions.explain: „you“ ile yardımcı fiil „do“; „does“ yalnız he/she/it ile.

questions.text: He ___ tennis on Saturday.
questions.explain: „he“ ile -s: plays. Rutin için -ing biçimi kullanılmaz.

questions.text: My mother ___ (work) at a school.
questions.explain: „my mother“ = she → works.

questions.text: ___ your brother speak English? (do / does)
questions.explain: „your brother“ = he → Does. Asıl fiil yalın: speak.

questions.text: They ___ (not / drink) tea.
questions.explain: Olumsuz: do + not + yalın fiil → don't drink.

questions.text: Soruyu doğru sıraya diz.
questions.explain: Soruda sıra: Does + özne + yalın fiil: Does she live here?

questions.text: „He don't like pizza.“ — Bu cümle doğru mu?
questions.explain: „he“ ile olumsuz „doesn't“: He doesn't like pizza.

questions.text: „We go to school by bus.“ — Bu cümle doğru mu?
questions.explain: „we“ ile fiil yalın kalır: go. Cümle doğru.

questions.text: Ali ___ TV in the evening.
questions.explain: Sonu -ch ile biten fiil üçüncü tekilde -es alır: watches.

title: My First Month at the Shelter
intro: Hayvan barınağında gönüllü olan birinin ilk ayını anlattığı blog yazısını okuyacaksın.
text:
MY FIRST MONTH AT THE SHELTER

Four weeks ago I started as a volunteer at the animal shelter near my flat. I go there every Saturday morning for three hours.

On my first day I was nervous. Marta, who has worked there for nine years, showed me everything: where the food is, how much water each bowl needs, and which dogs you can walk alone.

The work is not romantic. I clean cages, I wash blankets and I carry heavy bags. But then there is the other part. Two weeks ago I walked a small brown dog called Rocky. He was scared of everything - cars, bikes, even plastic bags. Last Saturday a bus stopped next to us and he did not run away. That felt better than any thank-you.

Two dogs found a new owner last month. One of them was Rocky's friend, so now Rocky is alone again. I know this is good news, but I was sad for a day.

If you have three free hours a week, go and ask them. They always need people.

questions.text: What is the text about?
options: The writer's first weeks as a volunteer.
How to choose a dog for your family.
A shelter that will close next month.
questions.explain: Başlık ve ilk cümle bunu söylüyor: dört hafta önce gönüllü olarak başladı. Kapanma ya da köpek seçme hiç geçmiyor.

questions.text: Who is Marta?
options: The writer's neighbor who has two dogs.
A woman who has worked at the shelter for nine years.
A visitor who wants to take Rocky home.
questions.explain: „Marta, who has worked there for nine years, showed me everything.“ — deneyimli çalışan, komşu ya da ziyaretçi değil.

questions.text: The writer thinks the work is easy and beautiful.
questions.explain: „The work is not romantic. I clean cages, I wash blankets and I carry heavy bags.“ — iş ağır, güzel olan başka bir şey.

questions.text: The writer goes to the shelter every ___ morning.
questions.explain: „I go there every Saturday morning and stay for three hours.“

questions.text: Why was the bus important for the writer?
options: It showed that Rocky is less scared now.
It showed that Rocky wants a new owner.
It showed that the streets are dangerous.
questions.explain: Rocky her şeyden korkuyordu; otobüs durduğunda kaçmadı. Yazar bunu „better than any thank-you“ diye anlatıyor.

questions.text: Why was the writer sad for a day?
questions.explain: İki köpek sahip buldu; biri Rocky'nin arkadaşıydı, „so now Rocky is alone again“.

title: Joining the Sunday Ride
intro: Nadir bir bisiklet kulübünü arıyor. Hangi grup, nerede, saat kaçta ve yanında ne getirmeli - dinleyip yakala.

segments.speaker: Nadir
segments.text: Hello, is that the Riverside Cycling Club?

segments.speaker: Priya
segments.text: Yes, Priya speaking. How can I help you?

segments.speaker: Nadir
segments.text: I saw your poster at the library. I would like to join the Sunday ride, but I have never cycled in a group.

segments.speaker: Priya
segments.text: That is no problem. We have two groups. The fast one rides sixty kilometers, the slow one rides twenty-five.

segments.speaker: Nadir
segments.text: The slow one, please. Where do you meet?

segments.speaker: Priya
segments.text: At the old bridge. We start at nine, so please come ten minutes earlier. We always leave on time.

segments.speaker: Nadir
segments.text: And what do I need to bring?

segments.speaker: Priya
segments.text: A helmet - that is our only rule - some water and a small pump. And please check your brakes at home.

segments.speaker: Nadir
segments.text: Is the route difficult?

segments.speaker: Priya
segments.text: It is flat for twenty kilometers and then there is one hill. Last Sunday it rained and we stopped after an hour, but this week the weather looks good.

segments.speaker: Nadir
segments.text: Perfect. See you at the bridge on Sunday.

segments.speaker: Priya
segments.text: See you, Nadir. Look for the yellow flag.

questions.text: Why does Nadir call the club?
options: He wants to buy a bicycle from the club.
He wants to join the Sunday ride.
He wants to put a poster in the library.
questions.explain: „I would like to join the Sunday ride“ - afişi kütüphanede görmüş, kendisi asmamış.

questions.text: Which group does Nadir choose?
questions.explain: Priya iki grubu anlatınca Nadir „The slow one, please“ diyor; yavaş grup yirmi beş kilometre.

questions.text: Nadir should be at the bridge at ten to nine.
questions.explain: „We start at nine, so please come ten minutes earlier.“ — dokuza on kala orada olmalı.

questions.text: What is the club's only rule?
questions.explain: „A helmet - that is our only rule.“ Su ve pompa öneri, kural değil.

questions.text: Priya'nın son cümlesini duyduğun gibi yaz.
questions.explain: „Look for the yellow flag.“ — emir cümlesi özne almaz.

questions.text: What happened last Sunday?
options: Nobody came to the meeting point.
It rained and the group stopped early.
questions.explain: „Last Sunday it rained and we stopped after an hour“ - bu hafta hava iyi görünüyor.

title: One Small Change
intro: Önce iki cümle kur, sonra bir arkadaşına son zamanlarda değiştirdiğin bir alışkanlığı anlat.

tasks.tr: Geçen cumartesi ilk kez gönüllü olarak çalıştım.
tasks.answer: Last Saturday I worked as a volunteer for the first time.
alternatives: I worked as a volunteer for the first time last Saturday.
tasks.hint: Past simple düzenli fiilde -ed alır ve kişiye göre DEĞİŞMEZ: I worked, she worked. Zaman ifadesi başta ya da sonda durabilir.

tasks.tr: Otobüse binmedim çünkü hava çok güzeldi.
tasks.answer: I didn't take the bus because the weather was very nice.
alternatives: I did not take the bus because the weather was very nice.
I didn't take the bus because the weather was really nice.
tasks.hint: Olumsuzda zamanı „did“ taşır, asıl fiil YALIN kalır: didn't take, didn't took değil.

tasks.prompt: Son birkaç ayda küçük bir alışkanlığını değiştirdin (yürüyerek gitmek, erken kalkmak, daha az şey almak - sen seç). Bir arkadaşına yaz: ne yaptın, başta nasıldı, şimdi nasıl, ona da öner.
checklist: Ne zaman ve neyi değiştirdiğini yaz
Başta nasıl olduğunu geçmiş zamanla anlat
Şimdi ne fark ettiğini söyle
Arkadaşına öner ve bir soru sor

phrases.de: About two months ago I started …

tasks.sample: Hi Berk, I have news. About two months ago I stopped taking the bus to work and now I walk. It is only thirty-five minutes. At first it was hard, because I had to get up earlier and my legs hurt for a week. Now I feel much better in the morning and I save forty euros a month. You should try it, because your office is even closer than mine. Let me know if you want to walk together on Monday. Selin

title: Three sounds of -ed
intro: Yazılışı hep aynı, sesi üç türlü: -ed kimi zaman „t“, kimi zaman „d“, yalnız t/d'den sonra „ıd“ olur.

tasks.hint: „walked“ tek hecedir: WOKT. Sonundaki -ed „t“ okunur, ayrı hece değildir.

confusions.fix: -ed'i ayrı hece yapma; „walked“ tek hecede biter: wokt.

tasks.de: We watched a film last night.
tasks.hint: „watched“ = WOÇT. Sessiz harften (ç) sonra -ed „t“ olur.

confusions.fix: „watched“ tek hece: woçt. Sonuna „ıd“ ekleme.

tasks.hint: „called“ = KOLD. „l“ sesli bir harftir, bu yüzden -ed burada „d“ okunur.

confusions.fix: Sonu „d“: kold. Ayrı hece yok ama „d“ duyulmalı.

tasks.hint: „cleaned“ = KLİİND. Yine „d“, tek hece.

confusions.fix: Geçmiş zamanın „d“ sesini yutma: kliind.

tasks.hint: „wanted“ = WON-tıd, İKİ hece. Kök „t“ ile bittiği için -ed burada ayrı hece olur.

confusions.fix: „t“den sonra -ed ayrı hecedir: won-tıd. Burada hece eklemek DOĞRU.

tasks.hint: „waited“ = WEY-tıd, iki hece. „hour“ baştaki h okunmaz: AUIR.

confusions.fix: „waited“ iki hece; „hour“ h'siz başlar.

tasks.de: He asked a very good question.
tasks.hint: „asked“ = AASKT, tek hece ve üç sessiz üst üste: s-k-t. Araya ünlü koyma.

heard: he ask a very good question
confusions.fix: Sonu „skt“ diye biter; hece ekleme.

title: did and the past
intro: Geçmişi anlatmanın temel zamanı: düzenli -ed, düzensiz biçimler ve soruda ortaya çıkan „did“.
focus: Past simple: düzenli ve düzensiz fiiller, did ile soru ve olumsuz

explanation.heading: Kişiye göre değişmez
explanation.tr: Türkçede geçmiş zaman kişiye göre değişir: gittim, gittin, gitti. İngilizcede past simple herkes için AYNIDIR. Şimdiki zamandaki „-s“ derdi burada yok.

examples.de: I worked late yesterday.
She worked late, too.
examples.tr: O da geç saate kadar çalıştı.
examples.note: she ile de worked, works değil

examples.de: We arrived two hours ago.

explanation.heading: Düzensiz fiiller ezberdir
explanation.tr: En sık kullanılan fiillerin çoğu -ed almaz; ikinci biçimi ezberlenir. Kural yok, ama liste kısadır ve her gün karşına çıkar.

examples.de: I went to the market and bought bread.
She saw the message but forgot to answer.
examples.tr: Mesajı gördü ama cevap vermeyi unuttu.

examples.de: They had a long day.

explanation.heading: Soru ve olumsuzda zamanı „did“ taşır
explanation.tr: Soru ve olumsuz cümlede „did“ devreye girer ve geçmiş bilgisini o üstlenir. Bu yüzden asıl fiil YALIN hâle döner. En sık hata budur: „Did you went?“ yanlış, çünkü zaman iki kez işaretlenmiş olur.

examples.de: Did you see the film?
I didn't understand the question.
Why did she leave so early?

questions.text: Yesterday I ___ my grandmother.
questions.explain: Geçmiş için düzenli fiil -ed alır: visited. „Yesterday“ zamanı belli ediyor.

questions.text: Which sentence is correct?
questions.explain: Soruda zamanı „did“ taşır, asıl fiil yalın kalır: Did you finish …?

questions.text: She ___ to the party because she was ill.
questions.explain: Olumsuzda da fiil yalın: didn't come. „not came“ diye bir biçim yok.

questions.text: We ___ (go) to the beach last summer.
questions.explain: „go“ düzensizdir: go - went - gone. Burada ikinci biçim gerekir.

questions.text: ___ they enjoy the concert? (do / does / did)
questions.explain: Geçmiş zaman sorusu „did“ ile açılır; „enjoy“ yalın kalır.

questions.text: I ___ (buy) this jacket two years ago.
questions.explain: „buy“ düzensiz: buy - bought. „ago“ geçmiş zamanla kullanılır.

questions.text: Soruyu doğru sıraya diz.
questions.explain: Soru kelimesi, did, özne, yalın fiil: Where did you buy it?

questions.text: „He didn't wanted to come.“ - Is this sentence correct?
questions.explain: „didn't“ zaten geçmişi gösteriyor; doğrusu „He didn't want to come.“

questions.text: „They arrived at ten and left at eleven.“ - Is this sentence correct?
questions.explain: Biri düzenli (arrive - arrived), öteki düzensiz (leave - left); ikisi de doğru.

questions.text: Soruda ve olumsuzda asıl fiil neden yalın kalır?
options: Çünkü İngilizcede soru cümlesinde fiil çekilmez.
questions.explain: Zaman iki kez işaretlenmez: „did“ geçmişi üstlenince fiil yalın hâline döner.

title: Learning to Swim at Thirty-Five
intro: Yetişkin yaşta yüzme öğrenen bir kadının blog yazısını oku: neden başladı, ilk ders nasıl geçti, bugün nerede.
text:
I have never been a confident swimmer. When I was a child, my family lived far from the sea, and the school pool was closed for years. So I grew up as the person who sat on the beach and watched.

Last spring, my daughter started swimming lessons, and she asked me why I never came into the water with her. I didn't have a good answer. The next week, I decided to sign up for an adult beginners' course at the local pool.

The first lesson was hard. I was the oldest person in the group, and I couldn't even put my face in the water. Our teacher, Marta, didn't laugh. She told us that fear is normal and that most adults learn faster than they expect, because they listen.

Since then, I have been to the pool twice a week. I have already learned to breathe in the water, and last month I swam twenty-five meters without stopping. I haven't swum in the sea yet, but we have booked a holiday for August, and this time I won't be sitting on the beach.

If you have been thinking about lessons for years, my advice is simple: don't wait for the perfect moment. Book the first class. The rest will follow.

questions.text: What is the text mainly about?
options: why the writer prefers the beach to the pool
how the writer's daughter learned to swim
how the writer learned to swim as an adult
questions.explain: Metnin tamamı yazarın kendi yüzme hikâyesi; kızı ve plaj yalnız başlangıç noktası (ilk iki paragraf).

questions.text: Why did the writer decide to take lessons?
options: Her teacher told her that fear is normal.
Her daughter asked a question she could not answer.
Her family booked a holiday by the sea.
questions.explain: „she asked me why I never came into the water … I didn't have a good answer.“ Öğretmenin sözü ve tatil daha sonra geliyor.

questions.text: What does the writer think of Marta, the teacher?
options: She expected too much from the group.
She was strict but very funny.
questions.explain: „Marta didn't laugh. She told us that fear is normal …“ — yazar öğretmenin anlayışını vurguluyor; sertlik ya da şaka yok.

questions.text: The writer has already swum in the sea.
questions.explain: „I haven't swum in the sea yet“ — henüz denizde yüzmedi; ağustostaki tatil ilk fırsat olacak.

questions.text: Since then, the writer has been to the pool ___ a week.
questions.explain: „Since then, I have been to the pool twice a week.“ — dördüncü paragrafın ilk cümlesi.

questions.text: How far did the writer swim last month?
questions.explain: „last month I swam twenty-five meters without stopping.“

title: Swapping Homes for the Summer
intro: Radyo sunucusu, tatillerini ev takasıyla geçiren Leyla'yla konuşuyor: sistem nasıl işliyor, başta neden endişeliydi, şimdi ne düşünüyor.

segments.speaker: Host
segments.text: Welcome back. My guest today is Leyla, who has spent the last three summers in other people's homes and let other people stay in hers. Leyla, how does a home exchange work?

segments.speaker: Leyla
segments.text: It's simple, really. You put your flat on a website, with photos, and look for a family who wants to visit your city. You agree on dates, and then you just swap keys.

segments.speaker: Host
segments.text: And you don't pay anything?

segments.speaker: Leyla
segments.text: No rent, no. You pay for the flights, of course, but for a family of four, that saves a lot of money.

segments.speaker: Host
segments.text: Weren't you worried about strangers living in your home?

segments.speaker: Leyla
segments.text: At first, yes, I have to admit. Before our first exchange, I hid all our photos and locked one room. It sounds silly now.

segments.speaker: Host
segments.text: So what changed?

segments.speaker: Leyla
segments.text: We came home, and the flat was cleaner than before. There was even a cake on the table. Since then, we have done it every year, and we've never had a real problem.

segments.speaker: Host
segments.text: Never? Not one?

segments.speaker: Leyla
segments.text: Well, once a guest broke a lamp. He wrote us a long apology and left money for a new one. Honestly, my own children have broken more.

segments.speaker: Host
segments.text: Any advice for someone who wants to try it?

segments.speaker: Leyla
segments.text: Be honest in your description. If the shower is slow, say so. Nobody wants surprises on holiday.

questions.text: What is the interview mainly about?
options: holidays in other people's homes without paying rent
renting your flat to tourists to make money
a website where families sell holiday photos
questions.explain: Leyla ev takasını anlatıyor: „you just swap keys“, „No rent, no.“ Para kazanmak ya da fotoğraf satmak yok.

questions.text: What did Leyla do before her first exchange?
options: She hid her photos and locked a room.
She paid the other family some money.
She cleaned the flat and baked a cake.
questions.explain: „Before our first exchange, I hid all our photos and locked one room.“ Pasta ve temiz ev, döndüklerinde buldukları şey.

questions.text: How does Leyla feel about the broken lamp now?
options: She thinks the guest should pay more.
It was not a big problem for her.
She is still angry with the guest.
questions.explain: „He wrote us a long apology … my own children have broken more.“ — özür ve karşılaştırma, olayı küçümsediğini gösteriyor.

questions.text: The guests pay Leyla rent for her flat.
questions.explain: „And you don't pay anything?“ — „No rent, no.“ Yalnız kendi uçak biletleri ödeniyor.

questions.text: Leyla'nın son tavsiye cümlesini duyduğun gibi yaz.
questions.explain: „Nobody wants surprises on holiday.“ — nobody olumsuz anlam taşır ama fiil olumlu ve tekil kalır: wants.

questions.text: How many summers has Leyla spent in other people's homes?
questions.explain: Sunucu tanıtıyor: „who has spent the last three summers in other people's homes“.

title: Should Ayla Get a Dog?
intro: Arkadaşın Ayla köpek almayı düşünüyor ve fikrini soruyor; önce iki cümle kur, sonra e-postasına görüşünü ve gerekçelerini yaz.

tasks.tr: Senin yerinde olsam yaza kadar beklerdim.
tasks.answer: If I were you, I would wait until summer.
alternatives: I would wait until summer if I were you.
tasks.hint: İkinci koşul: If + past simple (were), ana cümlede would + yalın fiil. Türkçedeki „olsam … -irdim“ kalıbı; koşul cümlesi başa da sona da gelebilir.

tasks.tr: İki yıldır bir köpeğim var ve bir kez bile pişman olmadım.
tasks.answer: I have had a dog for two years and I have never regretted it.
alternatives: For two years I have had a dog and I have never regretted it.
tasks.hint: Hâlâ süren durum: present perfect + for (süre). Türkçede „var“ şimdiki zaman; İngilizce geçmişi şimdiye bağlar: have had. never + üçüncü hâl: have never regretted.

tasks.prompt: Arkadaşın Ayla köpek almayı düşünüyor ve senin dürüst görüşünü istiyor. E-postasına cevap yaz: görüşünü açıkça söyle, en az iki gerekçe ver, kendi deneyiminden ya da tanıdığın birinden örnek ver ve ona bir soru sor.
tasks.stimulus: Hi! I need your honest opinion. I have been thinking about getting a dog for months. I live alone in a small flat, and I work from home three days a week. My neighbor says a dog would be too much for me, but I have wanted one since I was a child. What do you think? Should I do it, or should I wait? Write soon! Ayla
checklist: Görüşünü açıkça söyle: al, alma ya da bekle
En az iki gerekçe ver
Kendi deneyiminden ya da tanıdığın birinden örnek ver
Bir soru sor ve vedalaş

phrases.de: If I were you, I would …

tasks.sample: Hi Ayla, thanks for your message! In my opinion, you should get a dog, but not yet. I have had one for two years, and it is the best thing that has happened to me. But a dog needs a lot of time, and the first months are hard. Since I got mine, I have not slept late once! The problem is that you are away from home two days a week. If I were you, I would wait until you have found someone who can walk the dog on those days. Have you thought about a smaller dog? They are happier in a flat. Let me know what you decide! Love, Deniz

title: When Should You Leave Home?
intro: Gençlerin evden ayrılma yaşı üzerine kırk ile yetmiş beş saniyelik bir konuşma yap: görüşün ve en az iki gerekçen.

monologue.promptTr: Bazı gençler on sekizinde evden ayrılır, bazıları otuzuna kadar ailesiyle yaşar. Sence bir genç ne zaman kendi evine çıkmalı? Görüşünü söyle ve en az iki gerekçe ver.
bulletsTr: Görüşün: erken mi, geç mi, yoksa duruma göre mi?
Birinci gerekçe: para, bağımsızlık ya da aile
İkinci gerekçe ya da karşı görüşe kısa bir cevap
Kendi hayatından ya da tanıdığından bir örnek
Tek cümlelik sonuç

targets.de: In my opinion, …
The main reason is that …
For example, …
On the other hand, …
That's why I think …

monologue.sampleDe: In my opinion, young people should move out when they can pay for their own life, not at a fixed age. The main reason is that living alone teaches you things that nobody can teach you at home: how to cook, how to plan your money, how to solve problems on your own. For example, my cousin moved out at twenty, and after a year he was a completely different person. On the other hand, rents have become very high, and many young people just can't afford a flat. In that case, staying with your parents for a few more years is not a problem. That's why I think the right time depends on money and on the person, not on a number.
monologue.rubricHint: Görüş + en az iki gerekçe bekle; hedef kalıplardan en az üçü geçmeli. Present perfect (have become) ve koşul yapısı artı puan.

title: have done or did?
intro: İngilizcenin iki geçmiş zamanını ayırmayı öğren: ne zaman have + üçüncü hâl, ne zaman -ed; since/for, already/yet, ever/never işaretleri.
focus: Present perfect ile past simple: since/for, already/yet, ever/never

explanation.heading: İki geçmiş, tek -di
explanation.tr: Türkçede „Berlin'e gittim“ hem dün olanı hem hayatında bir kez olanı anlatır; İngilizce ikiye ayırır. Zaman belliyse ya da bittiyse past simple (yesterday, last year, in 2019). Zaman söylenmiyorsa ve sonuç şimdiyi ilgilendiriyorsa present perfect: have/has + fiilin üçüncü hâli.

examples.de: I went to Berlin last year.
I have been to Berlin twice.
She lost her keys yesterday.
She has lost her keys, so she cannot get in.
examples.tr: Anahtarlarını kaybetti, o yüzden içeri giremiyor.

explanation.heading: since / for: hâlâ süren durum
explanation.tr: Türkçede „beş yıldır burada yaşıyorum“ şimdiki zamandır; İngilizce bunu present perfect ile söyler, çünkü durum geçmişte başladı ve sürüyor. for + süre (for five years), since + başlangıç noktası (since 2021, since Monday). Aynı „for“ past simple ile gelirse durum bitmiştir.

examples.de: We have lived here for five years.
We have lived here since 2021.
We lived there for five years.

explanation.heading: already / yet / ever / never
explanation.tr: already olumlu cümlede have ile fiilin arasına girer („çoktan“). yet olumsuz cümlede ve soruda en sona gelir („henüz“). ever soruda „hiç“ demektir; never olumsuz cümlenin kendisidir, „hiç … -medi“ anlamını verir ve not ile birlikte kullanılmaz.

examples.de: I have already finished the report.
Have you finished yet?
Have you ever eaten Turkish breakfast?
I have never seen snow.

explanation.heading: En sık hata
explanation.tr: „I have seen him yesterday“ yanlış: yesterday zamanı sabitler ve past simple ister. „since three years“ da yanlış: since yalnız başlangıç noktası alır; süre için for.

examples.de: I saw him yesterday.
I have known her for three years.

questions.text: We ___ in Ankara for two years, then we moved to Izmir.
questions.explain: „then we moved“ — Ankara dönemi bitti. for + süre olsa da bitmiş durum past simple ister: lived.

questions.text: She ___ in this flat since 2020.
questions.explain: since + başlangıç noktası, durum sürüyor → present perfect: has lived. Türkçedeki „yaşıyor“ seni „lives“e çekmesin.

questions.text: ___ you ever been to Japan?
questions.explain: ever + been: „hayatında hiç“ sorusu → present perfect soru: Have you ever been …?

questions.text: We have known each other ___ ten years. (since / for)
questions.explain: „ten years“ bir süre → for. since yalnız başlangıç noktasıyla kullanılır (since 2015).

questions.text: I haven't seen that movie ___. (already / yet)
questions.explain: Olumsuz cümlede „henüz“ = yet, cümle sonunda. already yalnız olumlu cümlede.

questions.text: They ___ (move) to Izmir in 2018.
questions.explain: „in 2018“ zamanı sabitliyor → past simple: moved.

questions.text: He ___ (never / eat) fish.
questions.explain: Hayatında hiç: has + never + fiilin üçüncü hâli (eaten). not eklenmez.

questions.text: Soruyu doğru sıraya diz.
questions.explain: Soru sırası: Have + özne + üçüncü hâl + nesne; yet en sona: Have you finished your homework yet?

questions.text: „I have seen him yesterday.“ — Bu cümle doğru mu?
questions.explain: yesterday zamanı sabitler; present perfect ile bir arada olmaz. Doğrusu: I saw him yesterday.

questions.text: „She has already left.“ — Bu cümle doğru mu?
questions.explain: already olumlu cümlede has ile üçüncü hâl (left) arasında; cümle doğru.

title: The five-star problem
intro: Puanlama sistemlerinin neden işe yaramaz hale geldiğini anlatan bir yorum yazısı: sorun yıldızlarda mı, bizde mi?
text:
THE FIVE-STAR PROBLEM

Somewhere between the taxi app and the food delivery, five stars stopped meaning „excellent“ and started meaning „nothing went wrong.“ Ask any driver: a four-star rating is not praise. In many companies it is a warning, and below 4.6 the account may be closed. The scale runs from one to five, but in practice it has two positions.

This happens because we are not rating a service; we are deciding whether to punish a person. Most customers know that a low score can cost someone their work, so they give five stars to anyone who was not rude. The result is an average that looks precise and tells you almost nothing. If everything is 4.8, the number is decoration.

The second problem is who writes at all. People rarely stop to praise an ordinary experience. They write when they are angry, and sometimes when a company has asked them three times. So the ratings we read come mostly from two groups: the furious and the reminded. Neither is a good sample.

Companies know this, and some of them have quietly moved the threshold. One hotel chain now treats anything below nine out of ten as a complaint. Staff are trained to ask for a ten, which is why you are handed a card explaining that „anything less than ten means we have failed.“ That sentence is not information. It is pressure, and it turns the guest into an employee of the marketing department.

None of this means feedback is useless. Written comments still work, because they cannot be averaged. A single sentence — „the room was clean but we could hear every door“ — carries more than three hundred identical stars. The problem is not that people are dishonest. It is that we asked them a question with only one acceptable answer, and then treated the answer as data.

questions.text: What is the writer's main argument?
options: Customers deliberately give unfair ratings to punish companies.
Companies should stop asking for feedback of any kind.
Star ratings have become almost meaningless because of how they are used.
questions.explain: Yazı boyunca ölçeğin ikiye indiği, örneklemin bozuk olduğu ve baskının eklendiği anlatılıyor; son paragraf geri bildirimin kendisini savunuyor.

questions.text: Why do most customers give five stars?
options: They want the company to send them a discount.
They believe the service was truly excellent.
They know a lower score can cost the worker their job.
questions.explain: „a low score can cost someone their work, so they give five stars to anyone who was not rude“ — puan bir değerlendirme değil, bir karar.

questions.text: According to the text, people who write reviews are a good sample of all customers.
questions.explain: „the ratings we read come mostly from two groups: the furious and the reminded. Neither is a good sample.“

questions.text: What does the writer mean by „it turns the guest into an employee of the marketing department“?
options: Guests must fill in a form before they leave.
The hotel offers guests a job in marketing.
The guest is being asked to work for the company's targets.
questions.explain: On üzerinden ondan azını şikâyet sayan bir sistemde misafirden şirketin hedefini tutturması isteniyor; cümle bunun ironisi.

questions.text: One hotel chain treats anything below ___ out of ten as a complaint.
questions.explain: „One hotel chain now treats anything below nine out of ten as a complaint.“

questions.text: Why does the writer think written comments still work?
questions.explain: „Written comments still work, because they cannot be averaged.“ Tek bir cümle üç yüz yıldızdan fazlasını taşıyor.

title: Promote or hire?
intro: Bir müdür ve insan kaynakları sorumlusu boşalan pozisyonu tartışıyor: içeriden terfi mi, dışarıdan işe alım mı?

segments.speaker: Marek
segments.text: So, the vacancy. I want to promote Dilara. She has done half the job for eight months already, and the team trusts her.

segments.speaker: Ana
segments.text: I like Dilara. But I would like to see an external shortlist as well, even if we end up choosing her.

segments.speaker: Marek
segments.text: That feels like a waste of everyone's time. And if she finds out we interviewed outsiders, what does that tell her?

segments.speaker: Ana
segments.text: It tells her the role was worth a proper process. If we hand it over quietly, the other three people in the team never get to apply.

segments.speaker: Marek
segments.text: Nobody else wants it. I have asked.

segments.speaker: Ana
segments.text: You asked in a meeting, with you in the room. That is not the same as an open call.

segments.speaker: Marek
segments.text: Fair point. But there is a cost. An external hire needs six months before they are useful. We do not have six months.

segments.speaker: Ana
segments.text: Agreed, and that is a real argument for Dilara. I just want it written down as a decision, not as an assumption.

segments.speaker: Marek
segments.text: What would change your mind about the shortlist?

segments.speaker: Ana
segments.text: If we advertise internally for two weeks and nobody applies, I will drop the external search completely.

segments.speaker: Marek
segments.text: Two weeks I can live with. But I want to tell Dilara today that she is the strongest candidate, otherwise she will start looking elsewhere.

segments.speaker: Ana
segments.text: Tell her she is the strongest candidate. Do not tell her the job is hers. Those are different sentences, and one of them we can keep.

questions.text: What do Marek and Ana disagree about?
options: How much the new manager should be paid.
Whether the role should be advertised before Dilara is chosen.
Whether Dilara is good enough for the job.
questions.explain: Ana da Dilara'yı beğeniyor; tartışma süreç üzerine: „I would like to see an external shortlist as well, even if we end up choosing her.“

questions.text: Why does Ana question Marek's claim that nobody else wants the job?
options: Because he asked in a meeting where he was present.
Because the team was on holiday at the time.
Because two people have already complained to her.
questions.explain: „You asked in a meeting, with you in the room. That is not the same as an open call.“ — soru soruluş biçimi cevabı belirliyor.

questions.text: Marek accepts that an internal advertisement is reasonable.
questions.explain: „Two weeks I can live with.“ — Ana'nın koşullu önerisini kabul ediyor, yalnız Dilara'ya bugün konuşmak istiyor.

questions.text: How long would an external hire need to become useful?
questions.explain: „An external hire needs six months before they are useful. We do not have six months.“

accept: Those are different sentences, and one of them we can keep.
Those are different sentences and one of them we can keep

options: To let Marek decide without any process.
To interview three external candidates next month.
